50f00ec3d26fadea.title: Elf The Musical
50f00ec3d26fadea.desc: Elf, the hit Hollywood blockbuster movie has been supersized into a live theatre spectacular for this Christmas. With a massive stage featuring amazing film backdrops on a huge led screen, plus a cast that travels through the auditorium, everyone gets a close-up view of the action. The presentation features Santa’s flying sleigh, an audience snowball fight, indoor snowstorm, a giant candy cane journey from the North Pole, aerial cirque stars and giant tv screens so you don’t miss any of the spectacle. The story is hilariously recreated by a large cast of performers into the biggest live Christmas show in the UK. This Christmas Spectacular production features a book written by Bob Martin and Thomas Meehan (Annie, The Producers and Hairspray) and an original score of great songs by Matt Sklar and Chad Beguel in that has delighted audiences on Broadway and the West End.
